rule: Designed voices only. Never cloned from a real person (VIDEO_RE §9.4, CHARACTERS §4.6/§5.6/§13.3). A person and the cultural consultant pick one of the candidates; the voice_id is then locked and never regenerated.

api.design: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-voice/design  {voice_description, text, seed, model_id: eleven_ttv_v3} -> 3 previews (generated_voice_id + audio)
api.approval_line_tts: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/with-timestamps  model eleven_v3, the settings below

chang.voice_design_prompt: Warm, low baritone male voice in his mid-70s with a light East Asian (Mandarin/Korean-influenced) accent. Calm, unhurried, clear articulation, slight gravel, smiles audibly on jokes. Studio-clean but intimate, as if speaking to one person in a garage.
chang.preview_text: Good morning. I'm Chang. AI character. Real chair. Push your chair against the wall. Shoes on. One... two... breathe out... three.
approval_lines: Good morning. I'm Chang. AI character. Real chair.
In, two, three, four. Out, two, three, four, five, six. Again.
Heart condition or new chest pain? Get cleared by your doctor first.

approval_line_notes.text: Good morning. I'm Chang. AI character. Real chair.

sun.voice_design_prompt: Bright, crisp female voice in her mid-70s with a light Korean accent. Quick comic timing, dry, warm underneath, slightly raspy on laughs, precise consonants.
sun.preview_text: Sun Yoon here. One pot on Sunday, two lunches done. The grams are written in. Chang says it's his favorite. Chang says that about every soup.
approval_lines: 'Are you even real?' No. I'm AI. My opinion of your breakfast is real.
Seventy-five adults with slow, stubborn bathrooms. Kiwis, prunes, or psyllium for four weeks.
Fever over three days or trouble breathing? No soup. Call your doctor.
